text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about with T.M.
Opera
O...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oho! It appears the rather intense gaze I
was
feeling belongs to that cute little
audience!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She points toward a claw machine filled
with
Umamusume plushies.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Forever trapped within a glass cage,
they can
never bask in the sun that is my
presence!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And I, who brings light to this world,
shall provide
you support with an
inspiring opera!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
May your rescue scene be a success, so
as not to
crush the hopes and dreams of
those children!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
